scope: Display and convention rules published beside the calculation recipes across the o1k-wide night's fits, deeps and verifies. An app must carry these as data or rules to reproduce what publishers print.

entries.rule: Dhuhr adhan prints exactly two wall-clock values, 13:00 x183 and 13:15 x183, switching 15 Apr and 15 Oct; no solar term survives (best transit+margin scores 32/366).

Isha adhan is a 15-minute clock ladder of 19 steps (11 distinct quarter-hour values on ~20 hand-set switch dates), including one 30-minute drop on 1 Oct; the editorial switch dates defeat any angle or computational snap.

entries.surface: Shuroi Ulamo month endpoint, 143-month archive (4,343 days)
entries.rule: Dhuhr window's left bound is a wall-clock constant per era: 13:00 to 2019-06-30, 12:40 from 2019-07-01, a transitional 12:50 through Oct 2020; the 2019 convention change is dated to the day.
Fixed clock caps pin fajr at exactly 03:08 for 14 days and isha at exactly 23:06 for 13 days over the publisher's smooth internal curve; night-fraction and angle families all fail cross-season.
18/17 with hard 03:30 fajr floor and 23:30 isha cap printed literally; the caps bind far wider than the VIN declaration states (95-104 days per benelux2, 190-208 printed days per fit9).

entries.surface: Nono Grande Mosquee Mawaqit year (365 rows)
entries.rule: Dhuhr is pinned at a fixed 13:45 wall clock on all 365 rows (config-fixed, not computed).
Zouhr and assr print as fixed 13:00/16:00 national convention regardless of solar transit.

entries.surface: Ministry of Habous sheets and rebuilt portal (data/horaires-2026-MM.js, 190 cities)
entries.rule: Sheets print civil UTC+1 (the declared fuseau:GMT clock) and ignore the national Ramadan clock change to UTC+0; on 1 Ramadan the print still carries civil time, so a renderer must apply the clock shift itself.
entries.source: census/c41-worldtable/world-table-v2.md Morocco row; o1k-wide/methods18 (stated prose); o1k-wide/morocco1

entries.surface: Dar al-Fatwa five-region annual tables (masjidi platform, 366 undated rows each)
entries.rule: Fixed UTC+2 clock year-round while the platform config declares Asia/Beirut; the fixed clock must be handled as a rendering shift, and the year (2028) is inferred, never quotable as a published date.
Isha caps at exactly 22:10 for 89 days through the summer window.

entries.surface: Islamic Trustees printed sheet, page 2 (jama'ah layer)
entries.rule: Page 2's dhuhr prints at a fixed 13:00 clock while page 1 of the same print uses noon+15; one print, two clock conventions.

entries.surface: Centre Islamique de Noumea board (Mawaqit year, 365 rows)
entries.rule: Dhuhr/asr/isha land on the 5-minute grid as hand-maintained blocks, not computed values: dhuhr in 19 runs (2-6 weeks each) tracking transit+30, asr in 13 runs around shadow-1+2, with block envelopes no formula reproduces.

235 printed days are a polar-night synthetic: the boundary sunrise/sunset pair is held and crept ~0.2-0.5 min/day into solstice plateaus across three date ranges; only 130 honest days carry real geometry.

The table clamps through summer into a smooth solstice plateau (fajr longest run 9 at 02:20, isha 12 at 23:12) with a proprietary mechanism: frozenLatitude45 scores 0/118 and no standard cap reproduces it.

entries.surface: Executif des Musulmans de Belgique calendar (2025+2026)
entries.rule: Inside dated windows (isha 2026-05-01..08-12, fajr 05-10..08-02) the table prints flat plateaus plus lat-45 middle arcs instead of angle times; outside the windows the 18-deg isha curve returns; the 17-deg object is refuted.

Isha = maghrib + 120 on every Ramadan day and + 90 on every other day, month-exact on the API's own Hijri boundaries (1448 Ramadan is 29 days: never assume 30); zero violations across 6 Hijri years to 1500H.
Isha jumps to a 20:15 taraweeh override for exactly Ramadan 1447H (Feb 18-Mar 18), 20-35 min later than any twilight angle; the rest of the free season grades sunset+85 in 7-day blocks.
On Fridays the PDF prints the jumu'ah time (12:15) in the dhuhr column; a fit or consumer must skip or model Fridays.

entries.surface: Auburn Gallipoli Mosque own API (+ Diyanet diaspora tables)
entries.rule: Friday dhuhr rows are khutbah overrides deviating up to 55 min from the computed dhuhr.
12:30 Jumu'ah is written directly into Friday dhuhr per the publisher's own method statement.

entries.surface: FIANZ Ramadan sheets vs the same federation's Hilal Committee
entries.rule: The sheets start Ramadan Thu 19 Feb 2026 while the federation's own Hilal announcement says Fri 20 Feb: a table-vs-announcer split inside one body (D7 recommends the announced date governs Ramadan 1, the table's own times stand).
The 1447 edition prints fajr 5 minutes later on every day at the same angle and re-sets the isha block walk; every sun-anchored column is identical, so the change is editorial and dated by edition.

entries.surface: CERFI Dakar tables (2011 and 2026 editions, edition-stable)
entries.rule: Two-dawn convention: the column printed 'sunrise' is dawn-2 (Suba, sunrise-60.5), dawn-1 Fajar is sunrise-75.5, 15 min apart; the 2011 columns_note 'Suba = sunrise' is wrong, and reading that column as sunrise corrupts two columns.
entries.source: o1k-wide/fit3/REPORT.md; captures in o1k-wide/africa and o1k-wide/sahel2

entries.surface: Islamic Trustees sheet (2 pages) + masjidal feed
entries.rule: Three constructions on one print: page 1 is an angle table (fajr ~18.5, isha ~21.3, noon+15), page 2 a fixed-interval jama'ah sheet (sunrise-80, 13:00 clock, Hanafi asr, maghrib+80), and the feed is a hybrid taking page 1's fajr and page 2's isha with neither page's dhuhr/maghrib; the right object is a per-column table of which page each column comes from.

The dhuha column is astro_sunrise + (astro_sunset+3 - astro_sunrise)/4, a quarter of the daylight span, NOT sunrise+195; its offset from sunrise alone is latitude-dependent (190 Luanda to 211 Maseru).
Two-site rule, stated by the council: Fajr and sunrise are computed at Dilmunia (easternmost point), dhuhr/asr/maghrib/isha at Salman (westernmost); Eid at 4 deg altitude.
The four jamaat columns are fixed offsets from their adhan columns (+27 fajr, +15 dhuhr, +15 asr, +15 isha), printed alongside the clocks.
Printed offsets hold verbatim and must be carried as stated: suhoorEnds = fajr - 5 exactly (sd 0 over 90 rows), maghrib = sunset + 5, asr single-shadow with the double-shadow column +40.

entries.surface: Comunidade Religiosa Islamica de Lisboa calendar (2023/2026/2027)
entries.rule: The header states isha '12 deg + 3 min and 01:20' while the printed interval column is maghrib + 77 exactly; one recipe spans all three editions, so the header and the column must be reconciled as data, not taken at face value.
Summer isha prints a literal --:-- (null, not substituted) on 110-142 days; the null column must be carried as null, never back-filled from a bridge.
The published 45-120 minute clamp never moves a value (what fires is the unbounded quarter-night guard); reporting the clamp describes the code, not the output.

The modal form is LUPT's own construction (fajr = sunrise - F[MM-DD], isha = maghrib + I[MM-DD]); offset clusters are publisher-shaped, and 70 pc of towns are irreducibly per-town (~730 B arrays) - the UK outside London ships as per-town data or not at all.
entries.source: o1k-wide/fit14/REPORT.md; o1k-wide/fit4 and fit12; o1k-wide/uktowns2/REPORT.md; o1k-wide/verify3 (uk)

entries.surface: Masjidal range API, athan + iqamah layers
entries.rule: Two-layer rule (R3): the athan layer is platform-generated, the iqamah layer is tenant-bounded configuration; the two are never read as one table.
The flagged +1 is a one-minute column convention on subuh and syuruk together, not a recipe difference; both zones are JAKIM 18/17 at different reference points.

Turkish-label surface carries Diyanet-shaped column conventions (sunrise -7, dhuhr transit+5, asr Shafi +6, maghrib sunset +8); the solar columns need these conventions applied before they compare at all.

The fixed column offsets between every render pair (+3 sunrise, -3 maghrib, -3 asr, -1/-2 dhuhr) are the IslamicFinder widget's own conventions, not publisher data; only the fajr/isha delta between renders is the stated seasonal scheme.
Dhuhr = transit + 4.5 in CET months and + 9.5 in CEST months: the 5-minute safety margin lands DST-doubled, keyed to wall-clock seasons rather than solar time.

Window grammar: six window columns whose ends chain - dhuhr ends 1 min before asr (698/743), asr 1 min before the sunset bracket (734), the bracket 1 min before maghrib (714); isha ends at next-day fajr within a minute (684/720); maghrib's window is unchained at 40-41 min; fajr's right bound is the surface's own sunrise.

entries.surface: Presidency homepage iqamah widget; UAE AWQAF federal feed and IACAD city service
entries.rule: Iqamah is mosque-layer convention, never merged with the athan layer: KSA's presidency homepage iqamah column is defective (fixed 25/20/20/15/20 offsets on a mis-keyed adhan field, wrong at fajr/maghrib/isha), and UAE's federal feed is athan-only with mosque jama'ah times living behind a separate gated city service.
entries.source: census/c12-gulf/data/manifest.json (iqamahCaptures); census/c41-worldtable Saudi and UAE rows

entries.surface: WordPress dpt installs, Masjidal, Amanahly, mawaqit
entries.rule: Feed-vs-live gate (R5): a feed counts as evidence only once gated against its own live page; platform timezone and rounding fields are untrustworthy at ingest. Named recurrences: IANT Dallas's dpt year feed contradicts its own live widget all 364 days; Slough/Walsall defective installs; Toledo prints the whole DST window on standard time (sunrise exempt); San Antonio carries wrong-side asr on DST weekends; dpt filter=month ignores its params (parse what d_date covers).
entries.source: o1k-wide/decisions/DECISIONS.md R5; o1k-wide/americas/REPORT.md; o1k-wide/uktowns2/REPORT.md; o1k-wide/fit6/REPORT.md (job3); census/c41-worldtable platform table

entries.surface: Centro Islamico de Chile monthly ATHAN PDFs (18 cities)
entries.rule: belongsToDate rollover: archived Decembers print post-midnight isha as 00:xx on its own date's row - a 00:xx isha belongs to the previous civil date, and November's 23:59s are not truncation; the app's belongsToDate policy test case.

entries.surface: FML widget (dpt) vs printed monthly sheets
entries.rule: Two standing editions in the wild disagree stably (dhuhr +5 constant, maghrib +2/+3, isha +6..+10); the sheet's maghrib equals the widget's iqamah column daily; a fit and any display must name its edition (editionId, D1).
Never read a label as provenance: masjidway's 'UK Unified Timetable' is a platform method, not LUPT (the three towns carrying it drift +2 to +15 min).

Parse trap: the page prints dhuhr/asr/maghrib/isha in 12-hour form with no meridiem while fajr/sunrise are 24-hour, and dhuhr prints 11:59 in October in 24 hours; a naive parser produced 51 corrupt 23:59 dhuhr cells in the banked 2028 file.
The form's option values carry tatweel; exact Arabic spelling of the city strings is load-bearing for the request.

Mandatory trap suite at ingest: today-row anchoring, solar gate, byte-identity-vs-default, iqama form detection (minute offsets in some mosques, absolute clock times in others), TZ-FIELD DISTRUST, calendar-year resolution.

The grid's own footnote states 15/15 HANAFI dhuhr+5 maghrib+5 imsak-10 while its query form still says 18/17; the live grid measures 15 deg - trust the footnote and the measurement, never the form's stated pair.

The December +90 display rule in the record does not exist: zero days at a 90-minute isha-maghrib gap in any of six series; drop the clause (it misreads the summer quarter-night substitution as a winter rule).
The visitor-clock DST trap re-measures at exactly +60 on all columns: a rendered page's clock, not the data, shifts; a capture gate, not a recipe input.

entries.surface: Ministry Hijri calendar books, per-wilaya minute register
entries.rule: The per-wilaya register (6 prayer rows x 25 northern wilayas of signed minutes, reprinted monthly with recalculated values) is a DISPLAY AID, not the generator: regional books are computed at their own coordinates with the frozen Algiers recipe, and the register's own 4-min/degree rule misses uncovered books by up to 45 min.

The interval rules are edition-stable (fajr sunrise-70, isha maghrib+90, dhuhr noon+19) but the 8-city offset table moves between every edition except two cells; offsets must be carried per edition with the edition stamped.

Exactly six highland regencies (>= 1,786 m) print both twilights 1.0 deg deeper (21/19); it is Kemenag's publisher policy, not physics - Muhammadiyah prints plain 18/18 at Puncak Jaya's 3,396 m; carry as a named regional exception, never derive from elevation.
entries.source: o1k-wide/fit10/REPORT.md (id-highlands); o1k-wide/indonesia and sea2 (CONSOLIDATION); o1k-wide/decisions/DECISIONS.md D8

entries.surface: Jummah Masjid PWA 2026 year + publisher llms.txt
entries.rule: Six regional adjustment minutes as fixed symmetric tiers per region (+2 maghrib / -2 sehri, +3/-3, +4/-4) - three tiers x two directions, publisher-stated, no per-town curves.
Stated 19.5/17.5 Shafi carries per-city minute shifts on top (6 city-groups at the Podgorica anchor in vaktija.me's generator).
The offset table is a 3-group design (fajr+sunrise / dhuhr / asr+maghrib+isha), not render damage; the groups must be read as designed.
